title: Wake-Life(Jetski Rental)
specs: Valid boaters license required to operate Jetskis
All drivers must be 18+ years old
Jetskis seat 3 but only 2 riders allowed at a time
Multi-day rentals can have 2 drivers listed
includes: Jetski with full tank of gas for multi-day rentals
No fuel refill needed on 2 hour rentals
blurb: Wake-Life offers Jet Ski rentals with delivery available for multi-day rates. Rentals include 2 and 4 hour options with pickup in Alton Bay. Jetskis seat 3 but only 2 riders allowed at a time.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking · No refunds once booked · Remaining balance due on delivery morning · $100 service fee if fuel tank not full on pickup for multi-day rentals · No rain credit for multi-day rentals except possible credit for 2 day rentals with 24 hours of dangerous thunderstorms · Pickup in Alton Bay for 2 and 4 hour rentals; delivery available for multi-day rentals.
